digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutation counts are stale; mutmut 3.7.0 probe found 814 mutants in signing.py versus 491 in the old record, including both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps that cannot be bulk-fingerprinted.

Mutation shards must be promoted through three evidence-based modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with explicit per-shard enforcement policy, timeout values, and individually reviewed equivalent fingerprints to prevent blocking unrelated work while protecting changed behavioral cores.

The gate must use mutation-shards.toml as the sole source for shard mappings, freshly synthesized per-archive mutmut config, no cached mutation verdicts, and isolated 30-minute job limits per shard selected from changed source/test/support or global mutation-infrastructure changes.

Ratchet and strict modes must distinguish between AST-identical unchanged functions (preserving legacy survivors) and added/edited functions (requiring killed mutants or explicit fingerprints), with new no-tests outcomes reported but not blocking in ratchet.

Selector must map changed source, test, support, and infrastructure inputs to shards, keep both sides of renames/deletions, report unmatched Python tests, fail unresolved refs, emit JSON, and return explicit empty selection for no changes.

Workflow must use selector-derived per-shard matrix jobs with exact Gerrit patchset checkout, vote.needs inclusion, push/PR parity, weekly/manual all-shard selection, always-published artifacts, and diagnostic-only reruns that cannot turn red green.
